descriptionByLocale.en:
Interested in working in finance, specifically in Compliance and Operational Risk Control (C&ORC) Business Control Assurance team, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint that consistently ranks among the world's top financial institutions? We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2026 Off-cycle Internship Program within our Compliance and Operational Risk Control (C&ORC) Business Control Assurance business.

You’ll get to:

• participate in and successfully complete all required training, and help carry out Operating Effectiveness (OE) testing in accordance with the defined testing approach

• attend weekly/monthly progress meetings and contribute to discussions around control issues and failures

• address Quality Assurance (QA) review points promptly, maintain regular updates in the testing tracker, and ensure timely closure of all observations

• support by escalating any potential testing issues or exceptions to the appropriate teams
